metadata.title: 15-Month UPSC Preparation Roadmap
metadata.description: Comprehensive day-by-day study plan for UPSC Civil Services Examination

tasks.text: Read 'Laxmikanth - Chapter 1: Historical Background of Indian Constitution'
Read 'NCERT Class 11 History - Chapter 1: From the Beginning of Time'
Read today's 'Daily Briefing' - Current Affairs
Review unlocked flashcards (0 expected today)
Read 'Laxmikanth - Chapter 2: Salient Features of the Constitution'
Read 'NCERT Class 11 History - Chapter 2: Early Societies'
Read today's 'Daily Briefing' - Current Affairs
Review flashcards from Day 1 topics
Read 'Laxmikanth - Chapter 3: Preamble of the Constitution'
Read 'Laxmikanth - Chapter 4: Union and its Territory'
Read 'NCERT Class 11 Geography - Chapter 1: India - Location'
Read today's 'Daily Briefing' - Current Affairs
Attempt 10 MCQs on topics covered so far
Read 'Laxmikanth - Chapter 5: Citizenship'
Read 'Laxmikanth - Chapter 6: Fundamental Rights - Part 1 (Articles 12-18)'
Read today's 'Daily Briefing' - Current Affairs
Review all flashcards due today

day_5.theme: Fundamental Rights - Part 2 and Weekly Review

tasks.text: Read 'Laxmikanth - Chapter 6: Fundamental Rights - Part 2 (Articles 19-32)'
Read 'NCERT Class 11 Geography - Chapter 2: Structure and Physiography'
Read today's 'Daily Briefing' - Current Affairs
Weekly Review: Attempt 20 MCQs covering Week 1 topics
Write one practice answer (150 words) on any Fundamental Right
Read 'Laxmikanth - Chapter 7: Directive Principles of State Policy'
Light reading: Read today's 'Daily Briefing' - Current Affairs
Review all flashcards due today
Rest & Recreation - Watch a documentary on Indian Constitution
Complete Weekly Review: Revise all topics covered in Week 1
Attempt 30 MCQs on Week 1 topics (Mixed)
Plan next week's study schedule
Self-care: Exercise, meditation, or hobby

sample_note: This roadmap contains only 7 days as a demonstration. In a complete implementation, all 450 days would be meticulously planned with coverage of entire UPSC syllabus including History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Science & Technology, Environment, Current Affairs, and Ethics.
